summary: The PR adds get/set_antialiased methods to Text objects and adjusts the backend to respect these settings. The implementation seems correct and the tests pass.

issues.description: The new methods lack detailed docstrings explaining their purpose and usage.
The new test file name 'test_text_antialiasing.py' does not follow the naming convention used in other test files, which typically start with 'test_' followed by the module name.
